purpose: Prospectively test whether the selector-margin region that transferred positively in both prior disjoint GPT-OSS-120B development sets produces a strict gain on a third untouched MMLU-Pro identity set.
scientific_classification: sequential prospective confirmation; both prior result sets are development evidence for this threshold and are excluded from the new source

development_evidence.development_only_boundary: The 0.25 rule was chosen after both prior outcome files existed. Neither prior set confirms it.

frozen_policy.reliability_rule: If the semantic selector chooses revision and that revision is empty or max_token_exhausted, deterministically retain unchanged.

source.selection_rule: lowest SHA256(seed NUL identity) after excluding the public screen, every prior Q36 external identity, and both prior source-disjoint confirmations

execution.score_phase: single dependent CPU job after all candidate generation
execution.analysis_phase: single dependent CPU job after sealed selections and score

predeclared_success.capability: selected correct count is strictly greater than unchanged
predeclared_success.retention: selected retains at least 95 percent of unchanged-correct identities
predeclared_success.benchmark_success: selected correct count is nonnegative versus unchanged on MMLU-Pro
predeclared_success.strict_confirmation_pass: capability and retention and benchmark_success are all true

prohibitions: no threshold, reliability rule, source seed, prompt, decoding, shard, or success-gate change after this freeze
no selector or GPT-OSS revision retraining for this confirmation
no assessor access during source preparation, draft generation, GPT generation, or selection
no duplicate healthy generation or score job
no reuse of any identity from the public screen, prior Q36 source, or either prior confirmation
